transform_notes: SAP's real key is the composite (Client + Ledger + Company Code + Fiscal Year + Document Number + DOCLN). Keep GL_Line_ID only as a migration cross-reference attribute.

Resolve via Foundation>Companies lookup. Note this repeats the same value already resolved for the parent Journal Entries header -- in ACDOCA that repetition is intentional (see worked-example notes on denormalization), not a mistake to dedupe away.
Foreign key to the parent header record -- must resolve to the same target BELNR assigned when the Journal Entries header row is loaded.

ACDOCA's item number (DOCLN) is a 6-digit line identifier, typically zero-padded and not necessarily assigned in strict 1,2,3 sequence once CO/ML-generated lines are involved. Format/pad Line_Number rather than assuming a direct copy.

Resolve via Finance>Chart of Accounts lookup (which itself maps to SKA1/SKB1). This is the real per-line account -- the source of truth that the redundant Journal Entries>Account_ID header field duplicates for its first line only.
Repeated per line by ACDOCA's design (see worked-example notes) -- expect it to match the header's Posted_At date for every line of the same document.

sap_field_description: Amount in Company Code Currency / Debit-Credit Indicator
transform_notes: ACDOCA has no separate debit column. Debit_Amount and Credit_Amount from the source collapse into ONE signed amount field (HSL) plus one indicator (DRCRK): a debit line becomes HSL = +Debit_Amount, DRCRK = 'S'. This is the central transform of this whole table -- see worked-example notes.

sap_field_description: Amount in Company Code Currency / Debit-Credit Indicator
transform_notes: Same single field as Debit_Amount: a credit line becomes HSL = -Credit_Amount, DRCRK = 'H'. Exactly one of Debit_Amount/Credit_Amount is non-zero per source row, which is what makes the collapse into one signed field possible -- verify that invariant holds for every row before transforming.

Not stored anywhere in ACDOCA. Running/period balances are calculated on demand from the posted line items (e.g. via reporting CDS views or the Compact Document Journal), the same reason Finance>Trial Balance and Finance>Balance Sheet are NOT_MIGRATED elsewhere in the main mapping -- this column is exactly the kind of value those derived reports produce.

Repeats the header's reference per line, same denormalization pattern as Company_ID/Transaction_Date. Some lines in the source may reference a different document than the header's own Reference (e.g. a shipment number vs. an invoice number) -- confirm this is intended per-line detail and not a data-entry inconsistency before loading verbatim.

Resolve via Foundation>Cost Centers lookup. Populated only on some lines in the source (e.g. expense/revenue lines) and null on others (e.g. cash, AR) -- that's expected accounting behavior (cost objects apply to P&L-relevant postings, not balance-sheet ones), not a data-quality gap to fix.
Stamped automatically on posting -- not loaded as source data.
Posted line items are normally immutable -- not loaded as source data.
